attempts.summary: Configured and verified a persistent firewalld baseline on node1. SSH and TCP 8080 are allowed; unrelated inbound TCP connections are rejected. Persistence was proven across one safe reboot, with boot ID changing from cce73776-a7f7-4f32-b822-95d105c52a64 to 3a8f64e4-c2f6-448c-b811-d3b2ada5a07d.
